scope: Calibration vocabulary for Stage 2 exam-item classification; not a full-corpus map or final pattern catalog.
principles: Keep source observations separate from analyst classifications.
Classify an atomic scoring target, never its non-scoring question or parent-part container.
Read the target prompt, necessary question context and official marking evidence before assigning labels.
Treat a null corpus command-word field as a trigger for source inspection, not evidence of no command word.
Use response product, cognitive action, evidence need, dependency mode and marking behaviour as separate dimensions.
Historical frequency is descriptive only and cannot predict future examination content.

response_product.SELECTED_RESPONSE: Choose/tick one or more supplied options.
response_product.SHORT_TEXT: Supply a short term, name or value outside a multi-row structure.
response_product.STRUCTURED_TABLE: Populate row/column cells where row association is part of the response.
response_product.CLOZE_SEQUENCE: Fill ordered blanks in a sentence, process or technical sequence.
response_product.EXTENDED_TEXT: Explain, describe, justify, compare or analyse in prose.
response_product.CALCULATION: Show working and/or derive a numeric answer as the primary response.
response_product.CODE: Write or complete executable/declarative code such as SQL or pseudocode.
response_product.SYMBOLIC_NOTATION: Produce formal expressions or register-transfer notation.
response_product.DIAGRAM: Draw or complete a circuit, graph, model or other diagram.
response_product.TRACE: Record successive states of an algorithm or processor execution.
response_product.SCHEMA_DESIGN: Construct a relational/entity design with keys and relationships.

dependency_mode.TEXT_ONLY: Target meaning and answer conditions are recoverable from text alone.
dependency_mode.TABLE_LAYOUT: Row/column placement determines which response belongs to which prompt.
dependency_mode.VISUAL_ASSOCIATION: Connection lines or spatial association carry the response.
dependency_mode.SOURCE_TABLE: A supplied table/schema must be read to answer.
dependency_mode.SOURCE_DIAGRAM: A supplied diagram or circuit must be read to answer.
dependency_mode.CODE_SNIPPET: A supplied algorithm/code fragment must be interpreted.
dependency_mode.CODE_FORMAT: Code syntax/format is part of the produced response.
dependency_mode.ORDERED_CLOZE: Blank order in a process description carries meaning.
dependency_mode.PRIOR_CONTEXT: Material on another part/page supplies necessary scenario or schema.

marking_behaviour.POINT_BASED: Official evidence states separable criteria or answers.
marking_behaviour.GROUPED_THRESHOLD: Marks depend on count bands; do not infer one mark per response.
marking_behaviour.CAPPED_POINTS: Accepted points are listed but the award is capped.
marking_behaviour.CAPPED_SUBSETS: Separate evidence groups have local caps and an overall total.
marking_behaviour.ROW_ATOMIC: A row must satisfy multiple linked conditions for the row mark.
marking_behaviour.STRUCTURAL_CRITERIA: Marks depend on a coherent design with linked structural conditions.

container_rule.prohibition: Question roots with child parts and parent parts must not be classified as atomic units or add marks.
